subject: AtlasCloud reseller addendum - channel addendum coordination
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlascloud.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AtlasCloud reseller addendum - initial redlines

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Attached are AtlasCloud's initial redlines to the reseller/partner addendum (PDF) we discussed — primarily focused on: pass-through billing language for marketplace charges, indemnity carve-outs for marketplace fees, and a shorter SLA commitment tied to marketplace-listed SKUs.

High-level asks:
- Confirm Redwood will accept marketplace pass-through billing (we need an explicit pass-through clause referencing marketplace fees).
- Add language that AtlasCloud can list Redwood on the cloud marketplace with standard marketplace T&Cs.
- Limit warranty/indemnity exposure for marketplace sales (we propose a 30-day cure and cap tied to the order value).

We'd like to get these into a version we can present to procurement by end of week. I've copied Ethan (procurement) for docs and signature.

Attachments: AtlasCloud_addendum_redlines.pdf (redline)

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Partnerships
AtlasCloud

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-05-21T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: AtlasCloud reseller addendum - initial redlines

Karthik / Neha — reviewed Priya's PDF. Key notes and proposed insertion language below. I attached a markup with tracked changes (redline-markup.docx).

Summary of proposed positions:
- Pass-through billing: we can accept explicit pass-through language but need a clause that clarifies Redwood invoices the end customer or the marketplace as applicable and AtlasCloud is responsible for marketplace fees it elects to incur. Suggested language: "Where Charges are incurred through a third-party marketplace, Redwood will invoice the purchaser consistent with the marketplace's billing flow; Partner (AtlasCloud) is responsible for any marketplace listing fees and pass-through charges it elects to incur."
- Indemnity/warranty: counter-propose a 60-day cure period and a liability cap equal to the fees paid for the disputed Order Form in the prior 12 months (rather than unlimited exposure). That is a standard compromise for partner papers.
- Marketplace listing: allow AtlasCloud to list Redwood on marketplace subject to a mutually agreed listing description and Redwood's trademark guidelines.

Please review the attached redline. I left the bulk of the MSA intact and focused edits on the addendum and the Order Form references.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference
[Attachment: redline-markup.docx (DOCX)]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlascloud.io>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-05-21T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed compromise + next steps (AtlasCloud addendum)

Priya — thanks, and appreciate the patience. Laura's attached markup narrows the gap on pass-through and indemnity. Short summary of the compromise we can accept:

1) Pass-through billing: Redwood will honor marketplace billing flows. The addendum will include language that AtlasCloud is responsible for marketplace listing fees it elects to accept; Redwood will not absorb third-party marketplace charges by default.
2) Indemnity cap: 60-day cure + cap equal to fees paid under the relevant Order Form in the prior 12 months.
3) Marketplace listing: AtlasCloud can list Redwood provided the listing language is shared in advance and Redwood's trademark guidelines are followed.

If that sounds reasonable, we'll prepare a clean addendum and a short Order Form amendment for signature. I've included a DocuSign link for the Order Form amendment draft so procurement can review: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/SigningLink/abc123

Can we aim to finalize this by EOD Friday? If AtlasCloud needs exceptions, propose specifics and we'll escalate.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Business Development
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: OrderForm_Amendment_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlascloud.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ethan Lee <procurement@atlascloud.io>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-05-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed compromise + next steps (AtlasCloud addendum)

Karthik — thank you, this is helpful and a lot closer to what procurement requires. Two quick asks before we sign:

1) Pass-through phrasing: can we add a one-sentence note that AtlasCloud may, at its election, bill end-customers for marketplace-related surcharges and Redwood will not unreasonably withhold documentation that demonstrates marketplace fees (so AtlasCloud can reconcile charges)? This is just for procurement auditability.
2) Indemnity cap: procurement prefers a hard cap of the greater of (a) fees paid under the Order Form in the prior 12 months or (b) $50,000, instead of a pure prior-period fee cap. Is Redwood open to that guardrail?

If you need to escalate the $50k floor, flag it and we can pause signature; otherwise Ethan and I are happy to proceed with the DocuSign route once we have the two-line tweaks.
